text: That morning: Holmes and Watson come down to the sitting-room
why: Paragraph 7 says Watson dressed and went down to the sitting-room with Holmes, on the morning described in paragraph 2.

text: Has the lady in black run away from something for good?
why: A heavily veiled, agitated young lady arriving at dawn with something pressing gives a reader reason to wonder if she is fleeing; the wording does not point to an answer.

text: Has the lady in black run away from something for good? — she has fled for good
why: Offered only as a possibility, and her excited early arrival and concealing veil make it reasonable to consider; it reveals no later fact.
